document.abstract: Particle accumulation in clean room atmospheres can be prevented by laminar/flow clean air handling systems which make it possible to circulate much larger quantities of clean air through working chambers (clean rooms) than was previously possible. Existing darkrooms or other areas can be converted into clean rooms by applying laminar/flow equipment in modular form.
